description: Synthetic four-corner support bench for numerical tests. Not measured truck data or a full-vehicle calibration.

sprung_mass_kg.source: RCV support bench synthetic total sprung mass; not a weighed vehicle

unsprung_mass_kg.source: RCV support bench synthetic unsprung mass per corner; not a measured wheel assembly

suspension_stiffness_n_per_m.source: RCV support bench synthetic linear wheel rate; not a measured shock curve or motion-ratio conversion

suspension_damping_n_s_per_m.source: RCV support bench synthetic linear wheel damping; not a measured damper curve

tire_stiffness_n_per_m.source: RCV support bench synthetic unilateral vertical tire stiffness; not a calibrated RC tire

gravity_m_per_s2.source: Conventional standard gravity selected for this synthetic numerical bench

suspension_rest_length_m.source: RCV support bench synthetic neutral vertical spring mount separation; not shock eye length

tire_radius_m.source: RCV support bench synthetic undeformed rolling radius; not derived from Blender geometry

roll_inertia_kg_m2.source: RCV support bench synthetic roll inertia about the sprung-mass CG; not measured

pitch_inertia_kg_m2.source: RCV support bench synthetic pitch inertia about the sprung-mass CG; not measured

front_axle_x_m.source: RCV support bench synthetic front axle station; x forward from the sprung-mass CG

rear_axle_x_m.source: RCV support bench synthetic rear axle station; x forward from the sprung-mass CG

half_track_m.source: RCV support bench synthetic half track; y positive left from the sprung-mass CG
